items_all.title: Qt AI Assistant將退役，開發工具轉向ACP、MCP與Agent Skills
items_all.summary: Qt宣佈9月30日後不再隨Qt Creator提供或發布Qt AI Assistant，技術支援則在12月31日結束。Qt後續將開發資源轉向可處理多步驟工作的AI代理，讓Claude Code、Codex、Qwen Code及GitHub Copilot等既有工具串接Qt Creator，再搭配MCP與Qt專用代理技能，取得開發環境的操作能力及Qt、QML相關知識。

items_all.title: Perplexity Open Sources Lily: A Rust + Metal Inference Engine for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on Apple Silicon
items_all.summary: Perplexity has open sourced Lily, the local inference engine behind Hybrid Compute in Perplexity Computer. Built in Rust with custom Metal kernels for one model on one chip family, it averages 1.23x MLX-LM's prefill throughput and 1.35x its decode throughput on a 40-core, 128 GB M5 Max. The post Perplexity Open Sources Lily: A Rust + Metal Inference Engine for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on Apple Silicon appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Perplexity 已開源 Lily，它是 Perplexity 計算機混合計算背後的本地推理引擎。 Lily 使用 Rust 語言編寫，並針對單一晶片系列上的單一型號定製了 Metal 核心。在 40 核心、128 GB 記憶體的 M5 Max 處理器上，其預填吞吐量平均是 MLX-LM 的 1.23 倍，解碼吞吐量平均是 MLX-LM 的 1.35 倍。這篇文章《Perplexity 開源 Lily：基於 蘋果 晶片的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 Rust + Metal 推理引擎》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Qwen Developers Open-Sources zg (zvec-grep): A Local-First Search Layer Unifying ripgrep, BM25, and Vector Search
items_all.summary: We look at zg (zvec-grep), the local-first search layer that Qwen Developers just open-sourced under Apache 2.0. We explain how it puts ripgrep, BM25, and vector search behind a single interface, so an agent can move from a plain-language description to an exact line span without switching tools. We cover the deliberately small MCP surface, the on-device embedding catalog, and the authorization gate that stands between local content and remote models. The post Qwen Developers Open-Sources zg (zvec-grep): A Local-First Search Layer Unifying ripgrep, BM25, and Vector Search appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 讓我們來看看 zg (zvec-grep)，這是 Qwen 開發人員剛剛根據 Apache 2.0 協定開源的本機優先搜尋層。我們將解釋它如何將 ripgrep、BM25 和向量搜尋整合到一個統一的介面中，從而使代理無需切換工具即可從純文字描述精確到行跨度。我們將介紹其特意設計的精簡的 MCP 介面、設備端嵌入目錄以及位於本地內容和遠端模型之間的授權機制。本文《Qwen 開發人員開源 zg (zvec-grep)：統一 ripgrep、BM25 和向量搜尋的本地優先搜尋層》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Meet Switchyard: A Rust Proxy and Library That Routes and Translates LLM Traffic Across OpenAI and Anthropic APIs
items_all.summary: NVIDIA has released Switchyard, an Apache-2.0 Rust proxy and library for LLM traffic. It decodes requests into provider-neutral types, routes them with passthrough, random, LLM-classifier, or stage-router algorithms, and translates responses back into the client's format, so Claude Code or Codex CLI can run against vLLM, NIM, or Ollama unchanged. The project is pre-alpha and not for production. The post Meet Switchyard: A Rust Proxy and Library That Routes and Translates LLM Traffic Across OpenAI and Anthropic APIs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 輝達 發布了 Switchyard，這是一個用於 LLM 流量的 Apache 2.0 Rust 代理程式庫。它將請求解碼為與提供者無關的類型，並使用直通、隨機、LLM 分類器或階段路由演算法進行路由，並將回應轉換回客戶端格式，以便 Claude Code 或 Codex CLI 可以直接在 vLLM、NIM 或 Ollama 上運行。該項目目前處於 pre-alpha 階段，不適用於生產環境。這篇文章《認識 Switchyard：一個用於在 OpenAI 和 Anthropic API 之間路由和轉換 LLM 流量的 Rust 代理程式庫》最初發佈於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber: One Core Model, Two Access Envelopes
items_all.summary: Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber on September 2, 2026. Both variants run on the same foundational intelligence, split by safety mitigations rather than model size. Gemini 3.8 Flash is generally available at $0.75 and $3.75 per 1M tokens, introductory through December 31, 2026. Flash Cyber reaches 47.2% pass@1 on CWE-Bench and is restricted to vetted defenders through the Fairwind Program. This article covers the benchmarks, the token-for-accuracy tradeoff, and what deploying either one actually requires. The post Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber: One Core Model, Two Access Envelopes appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Google 於 2026 年 9 月 2 日發布了 Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber。這兩個版本基於相同的底層智能，差異在於安全緩解措施而非模型大小。 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的官方售價為每百萬代幣 0.75 美元和 3.75 美元，優惠期至 2026 年 12 月 31 日。 Flash Cyber 在 CWE-Bench 測試中達到了 47.2% 的 pass@1 成功率，並且僅限通過 Fairwind Program 認證的防禦者使用。本文將介紹基準測試、代幣與準確率之間的權衡，以及部署這兩個版本所需的具體要求。文章「Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber：一個核心模型，兩種訪問範圍」最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash is Google's third budget model in six weeks while frontier models remain MIA
items_all.summary: Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash, the third Flash model in six weeks, matches Claude Opus 5 on some agentic coding benchmarks at lower cost. But its "working harder" reasoning burns about 30 percent more output tokens per task, making it pricier in practice than its predecessor despite identical token rates. The article Gemini 3.8 Flash is Google's third budget model in six weeks while frontier models remain MIA appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Google's 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash 是六週內推出的第三款 Flash 模型，在某些智能體編碼基準測試中，它們的性能與 Claude Opus 5 相當，但成本更低。然而，其「更努力工作」的推理機制導致每個任務消耗的輸出令牌數量增加了約 30%，因此儘管令牌消耗率相同，但實際成本卻高於其前代產品。文章《Gemini 3.8 Flash 是六週內推出的第三款低成本模型，而前沿模型仍未面世》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all.title: OpenAI calls Astra its most dangerous model yet - watching what it does is only getting harder
items_all.summary: OpenAI is officially rating its upcoming Astra model as the first system with "critical" cyber capabilities. The company plans to keep it in check by monitoring the chain of thought. Problem is, that monitoring already counts as an unreliable mirror of a model's real decisions, and according to a report, Astra's new architecture pushes even more of its thinking into the unreadable. So the safety net might be getting weaker just as the capabilities jump. The article OpenAI calls Astra its most dangerous model yet - watching what it does is only getting harder appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 正式將即將推出的 Astra 機型評為首個具備「關鍵」網路安全能力的系統。該公司計劃透過監控其運行邏輯鏈來對其進行控制。問題在於，這種監控本身就無法可靠地反映系統的真實決策，而且根據一份報告，Astra 的新架構使其更多的運作邏輯變得難以解讀。因此，在能力快速提升的同時，安全網也可能不斷削弱。文章《OpenAI 稱 Astra 是其迄今為止最危險的型號——監控其運作變得越來越困難》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all.title: World Labs unveils Atlas, a single AI model that generates, reconstructs, and simulates 3D worlds from just a few photos
items_all.summary: World Labs, co-founded by AI researcher Fei-Fei Li, has announced Atlas, a world model that generates, reconstructs, and simulates 3D scenes from just a few images. The company claims it beats specialized models by anchoring all inputs in 3D space rather than processing them as flat sequences. Atlas can also generate robot training data entirely in simulation. The article World Labs unveils Atlas, a single AI model that generates, reconstructs, and simulates 3D worlds from just a few photos appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 由人工智慧研究員李飛飛聯合創立的World Labs公司發布了Atlas，這是一款世界模型，只需幾張圖像即可產生、重建和模擬3D場景。該公司聲稱，Atlas透過將所有輸入錨定在3D空間中，而非將其作為平面序列進行處理，從而超越了其他專用模型。 Atlas還可以完全在模擬環境中產生機器人訓練資料。這篇文章《World Labs發布Atlas：一款只需幾張照片即可生成、重建和模擬3D世界的AI模型》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all.title: llm-gemini 0.34
items_all.summary: Release: llm-gemini 0.34 New model gemini-3.8-flash for Gemini 3.8 Flash , with low, medium and high thinking levels. #146 Fixed async responses failing to record the resolved model version. Thanks, Charlie Tonneslan . #137 Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash (and 3.8 Flash Cyber, but that's available to "trusted defenders" only) today. Here are the pelicans for high, medium, and low. This is high: For comparison, here are the same pelicans generated using Gemini 3.7 Flash . Something I appreciate about Gemini Flash is that it's fast, cheap, and competent at things like HTML and JavaScript. I was messing around with it and prompted "make me a cool thing in html" and it built this , which is certainly a cool thing in HTML! Took 13 seconds, cost 1.8 cents. Your browser does not support HTML5 video. If you click through to the demo you'll see one more thing I built with Gemini 3.8 Flash. My markdown-svg-renderer tool lets me feed in the URL to a Gist with Markdown in and renders that markdown with fenced code blocks for SVG correctly rendered. I used Gemini 3.8 Flash (with my very basic llm-coding-agent coding agent plugin) to add support for HTML as well, so now any HTML blocks in the Markdown are rendered using a sandboxed iframe. Here's the transcript . Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , llm , gemini , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , llm-release
items_all.summary_zh: 釋出：llm-gemini 0.34 為 Gemini 3.8 Flash 新增 gemini-3.8-flash 模型，提供低、中、高三種思維層次。 #146 修正了非同步回應無法記錄已解析模型版本的問題。感謝 Charlie Tonneslan。 #137 Google 今天發布了 Gemini 3.8 Flash（以及 3.8 Flash Cyber，但僅供「受信任的防禦者」使用）。以下是高、中、低三種思考層次的鵜鶘圖。這是高思維層次的鵜鶘圖：為了進行比較，以下是使用 Gemini 3.7 Flash 產生的相同鵜鶘圖。我欣賞 Gemini Flash 的一點是它速度快、價格低，而且在 HTML 和 JavaScript 等方面表現出色。我試用了一下，提示“用 HTML 建立一個很酷的東西”，它就生成了這個，這絕對是一個很酷的 HTML 作品！耗時 13 秒，成本為 1.8 美分。您的瀏覽器不支援 HTML5 影片。如果您點選進入演示頁面，您會看到我用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 建立的另一個東西。我的 markdown-svg-renderer 工具可讓我輸入包含 Markdown 內容的 Gist 的 URL，並渲染該 Markdown，同時正確地將程式碼區塊分隔成 SVG 格式。我還使用了 Gemini 3.8 Flash（以及我非常基礎的 llm-coding-agent 編碼代理外掛）來新增對 HTML 的支援，因此現在 Markdown 中的任何 HTML 程式碼區塊都會使用沙盒化的 iframe 進行渲染。這是文字稿。標籤：ai、generative-ai、llms、llm、gemini、pelican-riding-a-bicycle、llm-release

items_all.title: Claude's new system prompt really doesn't want to reproduce song lyrics
items_all.summary: Anthropic publish the system prompts for their Claude consumer applications ( Claude.ai and the Claude mobile apps - sadly not for Claude Cowork or Claude Code). I love that they do this, and that they share not just the current prompts but historic changes to their prompts as well. They used to keep all of the prompts on a single page, but when I checked today I noticed they had re-arranged those prompts into an index page and then a page per model - here's the page for Haiku 4.5 for example, which has the original prompt from October 15th 2025 and an updated prompt from January 18th 2026. A neat thing about Anthropic's platform.claude.com/docs site is that it's designed to be usable by LLMs. You can add .md to any page to get back the content as Markdown - here's the system prompt index page and the Markdown prompts for Fable 5.1 . TL;DR: this makes it really easy to diff the prompts. Once Claude has decl
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 會發布其 Claude 消費者應用程式（Claude.ai 和 Claude 行動應用程式－可惜不包括 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code）的系統提示。我很喜歡他們的做法，而且他們不僅分享當前的提示，還分享提示的歷史變更。他們以前把所有提示都放在一個頁面上，但我今天檢視時發現，他們已經把這些提示重新整理成一個索引頁面，然後每個型號一個頁面——例如，這是 Haiku 4.5 的頁面，其中包含 2025 年 10 月 15 日的原始提示和 2026 年 1 月 18 日的更新提示。 Anthropic's platform.claude.com/docs 網站的一個巧妙之處在於，它的設計也相容於 LLMs。你可以為任何頁面加上 .md 字尾，將內容還原為 Markdown 格式——這裡是系統提示索引頁和 Fable 5.1 的 Markdown 提示。簡而言之：這樣可以非常輕鬆地比較提示之間的差異。不要複製歌詞 不要繪製受版權保護的角色或標誌 對 Claude's 回答風格的調整 缺少的結束對話指南 推薦的戒癮支援網站 可靠的截止日期為 2026 年 6 月 我如何跟蹤這些提示 不要復制歌詞 讓我們從 Fable 5 和 Fable 5.1 之間最有趣的區別開始：新增了一個關於不要複製章節QCAN不得複製歌曲、詩歌或書籍、文章中的段落，無論全部或部分——包括最後幾句、副歌或旋律、逐音符寫出的旋律，或使用者逐句貼上並聲稱是自己創作的歌詞。一旦 Claude 宣告

items_all_raw.title: Qt AI Assistant將退役，開發工具轉向ACP、MCP與Agent Skills
items_all_raw.summary: Qt宣佈9月30日後不再隨Qt Creator提供或發布Qt AI Assistant，技術支援則在12月31日結束。Qt後續將開發資源轉向可處理多步驟工作的AI代理，讓Claude Code、Codex、Qwen Code及GitHub Copilot等既有工具串接Qt Creator，再搭配MCP與Qt專用代理技能，取得開發環境的操作能力及Qt、QML相關知識。

items_all_raw.title: Perplexity Open Sources Lily: A Rust + Metal Inference Engine for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on Apple Silicon
items_all_raw.summary: Perplexity has open sourced Lily, the local inference engine behind Hybrid Compute in Perplexity Computer. Built in Rust with custom Metal kernels for one model on one chip family, it averages 1.23x MLX-LM's prefill throughput and 1.35x its decode throughput on a 40-core, 128 GB M5 Max. The post Perplexity Open Sources Lily: A Rust + Metal Inference Engine for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on Apple Silicon appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Perplexity 已開源 Lily，它是 Perplexity 計算機混合計算背後的本地推理引擎。 Lily 使用 Rust 語言編寫，並針對單一晶片系列上的單一型號定製了 Metal 核心。在 40 核心、128 GB 記憶體的 M5 Max 處理器上，其預填吞吐量平均是 MLX-LM 的 1.23 倍，解碼吞吐量平均是 MLX-LM 的 1.35 倍。這篇文章《Perplexity 開源 Lily：基於 蘋果 晶片的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 Rust + Metal 推理引擎》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Qwen Developers Open-Sources zg (zvec-grep): A Local-First Search Layer Unifying ripgrep, BM25, and Vector Search
items_all_raw.summary: We look at zg (zvec-grep), the local-first search layer that Qwen Developers just open-sourced under Apache 2.0. We explain how it puts ripgrep, BM25, and vector search behind a single interface, so an agent can move from a plain-language description to an exact line span without switching tools. We cover the deliberately small MCP surface, the on-device embedding catalog, and the authorization gate that stands between local content and remote models. The post Qwen Developers Open-Sources zg (zvec-grep): A Local-First Search Layer Unifying ripgrep, BM25, and Vector Search appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 讓我們來看看 zg (zvec-grep)，這是 Qwen 開發人員剛剛根據 Apache 2.0 協定開源的本機優先搜尋層。我們將解釋它如何將 ripgrep、BM25 和向量搜尋整合到一個統一的介面中，從而使代理無需切換工具即可從純文字描述精確到行跨度。我們將介紹其特意設計的精簡的 MCP 介面、設備端嵌入目錄以及位於本地內容和遠端模型之間的授權機制。本文《Qwen 開發人員開源 zg (zvec-grep)：統一 ripgrep、BM25 和向量搜尋的本地優先搜尋層》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Meet Switchyard: A Rust Proxy and Library That Routes and Translates LLM Traffic Across OpenAI and Anthropic APIs
items_all_raw.summary: NVIDIA has released Switchyard, an Apache-2.0 Rust proxy and library for LLM traffic. It decodes requests into provider-neutral types, routes them with passthrough, random, LLM-classifier, or stage-router algorithms, and translates responses back into the client's format, so Claude Code or Codex CLI can run against vLLM, NIM, or Ollama unchanged. The project is pre-alpha and not for production. The post Meet Switchyard: A Rust Proxy and Library That Routes and Translates LLM Traffic Across OpenAI and Anthropic APIs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 輝達 發布了 Switchyard，這是一個用於 LLM 流量的 Apache 2.0 Rust 代理程式庫。它將請求解碼為與提供者無關的類型，並使用直通、隨機、LLM 分類器或階段路由演算法進行路由，並將回應轉換回客戶端格式，以便 Claude Code 或 Codex CLI 可以直接在 vLLM、NIM 或 Ollama 上運行。該項目目前處於 pre-alpha 階段，不適用於生產環境。這篇文章《認識 Switchyard：一個用於在 OpenAI 和 Anthropic API 之間路由和轉換 LLM 流量的 Rust 代理程式庫》最初發佈於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber: One Core Model, Two Access Envelopes
items_all_raw.summary: Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber on September 2, 2026. Both variants run on the same foundational intelligence, split by safety mitigations rather than model size. Gemini 3.8 Flash is generally available at $0.75 and $3.75 per 1M tokens, introductory through December 31, 2026. Flash Cyber reaches 47.2% pass@1 on CWE-Bench and is restricted to vetted defenders through the Fairwind Program. This article covers the benchmarks, the token-for-accuracy tradeoff, and what deploying either one actually requires. The post Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber: One Core Model, Two Access Envelopes appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google 於 2026 年 9 月 2 日發布了 Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber。這兩個版本基於相同的底層智能，差異在於安全緩解措施而非模型大小。 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的官方售價為每百萬代幣 0.75 美元和 3.75 美元，優惠期至 2026 年 12 月 31 日。 Flash Cyber 在 CWE-Bench 測試中達到了 47.2% 的 pass@1 成功率，並且僅限通過 Fairwind Program 認證的防禦者使用。本文將介紹基準測試、代幣與準確率之間的權衡，以及部署這兩個版本所需的具體要求。文章「Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber：一個核心模型，兩種訪問範圍」最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: llm-gemini 0.34
items_all_raw.summary: Release: llm-gemini 0.34 New model gemini-3.8-flash for Gemini 3.8 Flash , with low, medium and high thinking levels. #146 Fixed async responses failing to record the resolved model version. Thanks, Charlie Tonneslan . #137 Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash (and 3.8 Flash Cyber, but that's available to "trusted defenders" only) today. Here are the pelicans for high, medium, and low. This is high: For comparison, here are the same pelicans generated using Gemini 3.7 Flash . Something I appreciate about Gemini Flash is that it's fast, cheap, and competent at things like HTML and JavaScript. I was messing around with it and prompted "make me a cool thing in html" and it built this , which is certainly a cool thing in HTML! Took 13 seconds, cost 1.8 cents. Your browser does not support HTML5 video. If you click through to the demo you'll see one more thing I built with Gemini 3.8 Flash. My markdown-svg-renderer tool lets me feed in the URL to a Gist with Markdown in and renders that markdown with fenced code blocks for SVG correctly rendered. I used Gemini 3.8 Flash (with my very basic llm-coding-agent coding agent plugin) to add support for HTML as well, so now any HTML blocks in the Markdown are rendered using a sandboxed iframe. Here's the transcript . Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , llm , gemini , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , llm-release

Their proposed method, […] The post Motional and MIT AI explains self-driving car decisions appeared first on AI News .

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI calls Astra its most dangerous model yet - watching what it does is only getting harder
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI is officially rating its upcoming Astra model as the first system with "critical" cyber capabilities. The company plans to keep it in check by monitoring the chain of thought. Problem is, that monitoring already counts as an unreliable mirror of a model's real decisions, and according to a report, Astra's new architecture pushes even more of its thinking into the unreadable. So the safety net might be getting weaker just as the capabilities jump. The article OpenAI calls Astra its most dangerous model yet - watching what it does is only getting harder appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI 正式將即將推出的 Astra 機型評為首個具備「關鍵」網路安全能力的系統。該公司計劃透過監控其運行邏輯鏈來對其進行控制。問題在於，這種監控本身就無法可靠地反映系統的真實決策，而且根據一份報告，Astra 的新架構使其更多的運作邏輯變得難以解讀。因此，在能力快速提升的同時，安全網也可能不斷削弱。文章《OpenAI 稱 Astra 是其迄今為止最危險的型號——監控其運作變得越來越困難》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all_raw.title: Claude's new system prompt really doesn't want to reproduce song lyrics
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic publish the system prompts for their Claude consumer applications ( Claude.ai and the Claude mobile apps - sadly not for Claude Cowork or Claude Code). I love that they do this, and that they share not just the current prompts but historic changes to their prompts as well. They used to keep all of the prompts on a single page, but when I checked today I noticed they had re-arranged those prompts into an index page and then a page per model - here's the page for Haiku 4.5 for example, which has the original prompt from October 15th 2025 and an updated prompt from January 18th 2026. A neat thing about Anthropic's platform.claude.com/docs site is that it's designed to be usable by LLMs. You can add .md to any page to get back the content as Markdown - here's the system prompt index page and the Markdown prompts for Fable 5.1 . TL;DR: this makes it really easy to diff the prompts. items_all_raw.title: World Labs unveils Atlas, a single AI model that generates, reconstructs, and simulates 3D worlds from just a few photos
items_all_raw.summary: World Labs, co-founded by AI researcher Fei-Fei Li, has announced Atlas, a world model that generates, reconstructs, and simulates 3D scenes from just a few images. The company claims it beats specialized models by anchoring all inputs in 3D space rather than processing them as flat sequences. Atlas can also generate robot training data entirely in simulation. The article World Labs unveils Atlas, a single AI model that generates, reconstructs, and simulates 3D worlds from just a few photos appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 由人工智慧研究員李飛飛聯合創立的World Labs公司發布了Atlas，這是一款世界模型，只需幾張圖像即可產生、重建和模擬3D場景。該公司聲稱，Atlas透過將所有輸入錨定在3D空間中，而非將其作為平面序列進行處理，從而超越了其他專用模型。 Atlas還可以完全在模擬環境中產生機器人訓練資料。這篇文章《World Labs發布Atlas：一款只需幾張照片即可生成、重建和模擬3D世界的AI模型》最初發表於The Decoder網站。
